name: DenseVoxelDraw FrontPeek
definition: A rendering method similar to Front but with scaling and 'peek' capability, drawing top and front faces if the voxel is on the top boundary or has empty space above it.
summary: DenseVoxelDraw FrontPeek is a front-view rendering method that extends standard front rendering by adding scaling and a peek capability to draw top and front faces when a voxel is on the top boundary or has empty space above it.
